title: Scoped Egress Profiles + Ephemeral Public Sharing Block for Admin Policy Layer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Customers have asked for more granular admin controls that can both enforce strict egress policy and allow temporary, auditable exceptions. Current org-level "allowlist" and global export toggles are too coarse for use cases where teams need per-project or per-route controls, and where security teams want enforced temporal blocks on public sharing. This ticket scopes an implementation for: 1) Scoped Egress Profiles (org -> project -> route scoping) with precedence rules and contextual overrides tied to RBAC v2; 2) An 'ephemeral public sharing block' toggle that prevents creation of public shares for a configurable time window (or until an approval event); and 3) Audit enrichment to capture policy evaluation decisions so the console and audit logs can explain why a request was allowed or denied.
acceptance_criteria: Scoped egress profile config object exists in admin API (org/project/route) and persists via existing config store
Policy precedence implemented: route -> project -> org with explicit deny taking precedence over allow
Ephemeral public sharing block toggle available in Console and admin API, with UI control and API flag 'ephemeral_sharing_block_until'
All policy evaluations emit structured audit events with fields: policy_id, decision, evaluated_by_role, evaluated_at, evaluated_against_profile
RBAC v2 enforcement: only users with 'admin.policy.override' may create temporal exceptions; attempts logged and surfaced in console
E2E tests cover enforcement for 3 example workflows: standard request allowed by profile, blocked due to ephemeral toggle, and temporary exception granted and revoked
tasks: Design: define scoped egress profile schema and precedence rules (Product + Security)
API: extend admin config API to CRUD scoped profiles and ephemeral sharing flags
Runtime: integrate policy evaluation into request ingress path with caching for low-latency decisions
Audit: add policy_evaluation audit event and wire to existing audit-log pipeline
Console: add UX to create/manage scoped profiles and show active ephemeral blocks
RBAC: add new permission 'admin.policy.override' and mapping for SSO/SAML groups
Migration: convert existing org-level allowlists into an org-scoped profile with a migration script
Tests: unit, integration, and contract tests; add a replay-based test for audit events
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): API + audit events only, feature-flagged, internal orgs enabled
Phase 2: Console UX + policy enforcement for non-critical routes; gather metrics
Phase 3: Full enforcement across hosted runtime, migration of org allowlists, public docs
Rollback: admin API to set 'ephemeral_sharing_block_until' to null and disable scoped profiles via admin-only flag
telemetry: Dashboards: policy hit-rate by org/project, denied-by-policy trends, ephemeral-blocks active over time
Audit schema: event_type=policy_evaluation, fields=[policy_id, decision, reason, subject_id, subject_role, evaluated_at, ttl]
notes: Trade-offs: evaluating policies synchronously adds ~1ms median to ingress (estimate) but avoids eventual inconsistencies; we will optimize with an LRU cache keyed by (org, project, route, tokenScope)
Decision: explicit denies win over allows to keep conservative security posture; documented in design spec
Consideration: allow time-limited exceptions to be granted by SSO groups mapped to RBAC v2 roles; require MFA for high-risk orgs
